svg.aria-label: One model, five roles: Five roles share one Claude Sonnet 4.6 model. Each role has its own system prompt and temperature. Moderator: Opens with a sharp focus question, then distils each round into agreement, disagreement and a sharper follow-up. Proposer and critic: The proposer argues for, the critic argues against. Both engage the other side directly. Both have research tools. ReAct per debater turn: Up to MAX_TOOL_CALLS = 4 calls to tavily_search / tavily_extract, then prose. Sources appear inline as [claim](https://url) links. Judge: Ends each round: continue, or emit a verdict. An optional max_rounds cap (default 3) is defence in depth. Output: The full transcript, a VERDICT: line, and both trace URLs. An excerpt is in docs/REFERENCE.md
